{{MultipleIssues|citation|moresources}}
[[File:Xwing2-SWE.png|thumb|right|300px|The X-wing was one of the most well known snubfighters]]
{{Quote|You were lucky that time in the snubship. I probably won't have the patience to let you last as long as you deserve.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] taunting [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>}}
'''Snubfighters''' or '''snubships''' was a slang term to describe fighter models which usually carried a [[Pilot/Legends|crew]] of one or two. The snubfighters were equipped to attack ground targets and warships along with other fighters. Because of this role they typically carried missiles or torpedoes in addition to laser or blaster based weaponry. They also often include a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] to allow [[Planet/Legends|planet]] based fighters to attack targets in nearby systems, or to allow deployment from [[carrier]]s without forcing the carriers to enter battle directly.

In the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], Republic and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Forces deployed the [[S-100 Stinger-class starfighter]] while the later [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter]] used during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] would see service for thousands of years. In the last years of the Republic the Naboo developed the [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] to defend their world, and the Republic made wide use of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] and [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] models. Snubfighters were also the fighters of choice for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] with variations of or models based on the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] serving each group often alongside many other models of snubfighter.
